name: vs-table
description: A data table: sorting, search, column filters, client or server paging, selection, row actions, columns, CSV export, totals, keyboard grid, phone layouts.

attributes.name: key-field
attributes.description: The field that identifies a row.

attributes.name: page-sizes
attributes.description: Page sizes the user may choose.

attributes.name: search
attributes.description: A search box: every word somewhere in the shown columns.

attributes.name: export
attributes.description: An Export button: CSV of the matching rows.

attributes.name: column-chooser
attributes.description: A Columns button to show or hide columns.

attributes.name: remember
attributes.description: Keeps columns, widths, sorting and page size in this browser under this key.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: A maximum height; the body scrolls under a sticky header.

attributes.name: phone-layout
attributes.description: Under 600px wide: scroll sideways, or each row as a card.

attributes.name: empty-text
attributes.description: Shown when there are no rows.

properties.name: source
properties.description: Data from a server: paging, sorting and search there.

properties.name: rowClass
properties.description: A class (and part name) per row.
